review.notes: Triage review of the 212-page document within a fixed time budget. (1) Structural scan of the whole OCR markdown: zero code fences, so no swallowed headings, tables or images; image embeds and heading inventory checked programmatically. (2) Automated droppage scan of all 212 pages: normalized 4-gram containment of each PDF page's extracted text against the OCR (whole-document, threshold 75%) plus 6-word shingle sentence scan; the six low-containment pages (65, 67, 75, 108, 114, 167) were inspected line-by-line and are table/blank-page fragmentation false positives - Tables 4.2.A/B, 4.3.1.A/B, 4.4.3.A/B and 8.1.A match the PDF values. (3) Systematic footnote audit: all 25 printed footnote bodies are missing from the OCR; each was transcribed from rendered page bottoms (210 dpi composites, visually read) and inserted after the OCR paragraph or list carrying the matching $^{N}$ marker. (4) The OCR's six "depreciation" misreads and two merged appendix-table-cell spacing defects were verified on rendered pages (110-130 dpi, p.208 at page scale). Pages reviewed line-by-line are those listed; the remaining pages were covered only by the machine scans. Unnumbered headings promoted by OCR (e.g. '## We report three metrics:') were not judged in this pass - see unresolved.
